name: Destroyer Saber Design
description: The Destroyer Saber Design was a custom lightsaber hilt owned by the droid Hunter J-3DI that he could wield for the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition on Vespaara as an alternative to his standard lightsaber. It was designed in a way that was meant to invoke the aesthetics of the various Star Destroyers deployed by the Galactic Empire, including a small replica shield generator dome attached to the bottom of the hilt.
